name: Qilimanjaro
description: Qilimanjaro Quantum Tech builds full-stack analog quantum computers based on superconducting fluxonium qubits. A spin-off of IFAE, BSC, and the University of Barcelona, the company won the Quantum Spain tender to build the first Spanish quantum computer and operates the first multimodal quantum data center in Europe at the Barcelona Supercomputing Center.

products.name: Analog Quantum Processor
products.description: Full-stack superconducting quantum annealer based on fluxonium qubits for optimization workloads

products.name: Qilimanjaro Cloud
products.description: Cloud access platform for running quantum optimization tasks on Qilimanjaro analog quantum hardware
